statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog will add at least one new CVE entry for a remote access, remote support, or remote monitoring and management software product, distinct from CVE-2026-58704 and the ScreenConnect vulnerability reported on 2026-09-16, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog (cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) contains at least one entry for a remote access, remote support, or RMM software product (primary function is remote administration or remote screen/file access of another machine) with dateAdded between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21 inclusive, and that CVE is not CVE-2026-58704 and not the ScreenConnect CVE reported 2026-09-16; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-10-23, the CISA KEV catalog shows no dateAdded entry between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21 for any product meeting the remote access, remote support, or RMM definition above, other than the two already-catalogued CVEs excluded by the statement.

statement: CenterPoint Energy Inc. will file a disclosure with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (an 8-K, 8-K/A, or 10-Q) between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-15 that states a specific number of individuals, customers, or records affected by the cyberattack disclosed around 2026-09-15, and that number will exceed 100000.
resolution: TRUE if SEC EDGAR full-text search shows a CenterPoint Energy Inc. (NYSE: CNP) filing dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-15 that discloses a specific affected-individual or affected-record count for the cyberattack first reported 2026-09-15, and the stated count exceeds 100000; FALSE otherwise, including if no quantified figure is filed by the deadline.
failure_condition: By 2026-11-17, SEC EDGAR shows no CenterPoint Energy filing dated 2026-09-23 through 2026-11-15 that states an affected-individual or affected-record count above 100000 for this incident, whether because no quantified figure was filed or the filed figure was 100000 or below.

statement: WTI crude oil (NYMEX front-month futures) will record a settlement price at or above 110.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21. Reference: 101.87 USD per barrel on the packet date, 2026-09-16.
resolution: TRUE if the NYMEX WTI front-month futures settlement price (as published by CME Group or the US Energy Information Administration) equals or exceeds 110.00 USD per barrel on any trading day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-21 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The NYMEX WTI front-month settlement price stays below 110.00 USD per barrel on every trading day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-21.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury note yield will close at or above 5.10 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21. Reference: 4.96 percent on the packet date, 2026-09-16.
resolution: TRUE if the US Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve Rates (treasury.gov) or a major financial data provider (Bloomberg, Reuters) shows the 10-year Treasury yield closing at or above 5.10 percent on any trading day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-21 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury yield closes below 5.10 percent on every trading day from 2026-09-23 through 2026-10-21.

statement: A Houthi-launched missile, drone, or projectile will impact, be credibly reported as inbound toward, or be intercepted within 50 kilometers of Mecca, Saudi Arabia, with the launch or impact event occurring between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: TRUE if two or more independent wire services (Reuters, AP, AFP) or two opposing-side channels report a Houthi-attributed missile, drone, or projectile launch, impact, or interception within 50 kilometers of Mecca, with the event dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-15; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No corroborated report (two or more independent wire services or two opposing-side channels) of a Houthi-attributed missile, drone, or projectile launch, impact, or interception within 50 kilometers of Mecca appears with an event date between 2026-09-23 and 2026-11-15.

statement: The European Commission will publish a formal proposal document (a Commission Communication, draft Council Decision, or equivalent published policy text) establishing or defining associate member status for Canada, dated between 2026-09-23 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: TRUE if the European Commission publishes, via its official press corner or the Official Journal of the European Union, a formal proposal document (Communication, draft Council Decision, or similar legal or policy instrument) specifically defining or establishing an EU associate member status for Canada, dated between 2026-09-23 and 2027-01-15; FALSE otherwise, including if discussion remains at the level of statements, invitations, or informal proposals.
failure_condition: No formal Commission Communication, draft Council Decision, or equivalent published legal or policy instrument defining EU associate member status for Canada appears, dated between 2026-09-23 and 2027-01-15; continued statements or informal proposals without a published formal instrument count as a MISS.

statement: Democrats will win a majority of seats in the US Senate in the 2026 midterm elections held on 2026-11-03, as called by the Associated Press or a majority of major US television networks (ABC, CBS, NBC, CNN, Fox).
resolution: TRUE if, by the deadline, the Associated Press or a majority of the named networks have called Senate control for the Democratic Party (caucus, including independents caucusing with Democrats, holding 51 or more seats, or 50 seats with a Democratic Vice President tie-break) following the 2026-11-03 election; FALSE otherwise, including if control remains uncalled or is called for Republicans.
failure_condition: By 2026-11-13, the Associated Press and a majority of the named networks have not called Senate control for the Democratic Party, whether because control was called for Republicans or because the chamber's control remained too close to call.

statement: The US Department of the Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control will designate at least one additional Russian individual or entity, in a press release or Federal Register notice that explicitly references the assassination-plot allegation against Ukrainian-aligned individuals overseas reported around 2026-09-16, with the designation dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if OFAC (via a Treasury press release or a Federal Register notice) designates at least one Russian individual or entity and the designation text explicitly references the assassination or targeted-killing plot against Ukraine-aligned individuals abroad first reported around 2026-09-16, with the designation dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-12-15; FALSE otherwise, including if new Russia-related designations occur in this window without explicit reference to this specific allegation.
failure_condition: By 2026-12-17, no OFAC press release or Federal Register notice dated 2026-09-23 through 2026-12-15 designates a Russian individual or entity with text explicitly referencing this specific assassination-plot allegation.

statement: GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System) will issue a wildfire alert at Orange or Red level, above the Green level shown for Zambia, Mozambique, and the Democratic Republic of Congo on 2026-09-16, for any country in Sub-Saharan Africa, with the alert dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21.
resolution: TRUE if the GDACS wildfire alert feed (gdacs.org) publishes an Orange or Red level wildfire alert for any Sub-Saharan African country, dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21 inclusive; FALSE otherwise, including if only Green-level notifications continue to be issued.
failure_condition: By 2026-10-23, the GDACS wildfire alert feed shows no Orange or Red level alert for any Sub-Saharan African country dated between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21; only Green-level or no notifications appear in that window.
